audience: HR and people teams at small companies who manage staff in CharlieHR

useCases.title: See who is off on leave in a date window
useCases.text: The AI lists leave requests of the company in a date window, with team member, status, request type and dates, and the leave types.

useCases.title: Check the holiday allowance left per person
useCases.text: The AI reads the allowance, used and remaining days or hours of every team member, and the adjustments of one person.

useCases.title: List team members by office, team or manager
useCases.text: The AI lists team members with office, manager, teams, job title and start date, and the offices and teams of the company.

useCases.title: See where team members work on a day
useCases.text: The AI lists working locations, shows where each team member works on a date, and reads the working weeks of one person.

useCases.title: Check company holidays and restricted leave dates
useCases.text: The AI lists bank holidays and closures, and the dates when leave is restricted, such as a year-end freeze, in a date window.

useCases.title: Add a custom note to a team member's profile
useCases.text: The AI reads the note types, such as Employee No., and adds a note value to a team member. It is visible to whoever the note type allows.
